s.d: servant, slave; in the NT a person owned as a possession for various lengths of times (Hebrew slaves no more than seven years, Gentile slaves without time limit), of lower social status than free persons or masters; slaves could earn or purchase their freedom a male slave, or servant, of various degrees, [[matthew 8 9|Mt. 8:9]], and frequently ; a servitor, person of mean condition, [[philippians 2 7|Phil. 2:7;]] feminine δούλη, a female slave; a handmaiden, [[luke 1 38|Lk. 1:38, 48]]; [[acts 2 18|Acts 2:18;]] δοῦλος, used figuratively, in a bad sense, one involved in moral or spiritual thraldom, [[john 8 34|Jn. 8:34]]; [[romans 6 17|Rom. 6:17, 20]]; [[1-corinthians 7 23|1Cor. 7:23;]] [[2-peter 2 19|2Pet. 2:19;]] in a good sense, a devoted servant or minister, [[acts 16 17|Acts 16:17;]] [[romans 1 1|Rom. 1:1;]] one pledged or bound to serve, [[1-corinthians 7 22|1Cor. 7:22;]] [[2-corinthians 4 5|2Cor. 4:5]]

δουλόω, -ῶ (δοῦλος), [in LXX for עָבַד ;] to enslave, bring into bondage: [[acts 7 6|Act.7:6]] (LXX), [[2-peter 2 19|2Pe.2:19;]] metaphorically, [[1-corinthians 9 19|1Co.9:19;]] pass., before ἐν, [[1-corinthians 7 15|1Co.7:15;]] τ. θεῷ, [[romans 6 22|Rom.6:22;]] τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, [[romans 6 18|Rom.6:18;]] οἴνῳ, [[titus 2 3|Tit.2:3;]] ὑπὸ τὰ στοιχεῖα τ. κόσμου, [[galatians 4 3|Gal.4:3]] (Cremer, 217).† (AS)
δοχή, -ῆς, ἡ (δέχομαι), [in LXX: [[genesis 21 8|Gen.21:8]], [[esther 1 3|Est.1:3]], al. (מִשְׁתֶּה), Dan LXX 5:1 (לֶחֶם) ;] a feast, banquet: [[luke 5 29|Luk.5:29 14:13]].† (AS)
δράκων, -ο τος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for תַּנִּין ;] a dragon, a mythical monster: figuratively, of Satan, [[revelation 12 3|Rev.12:3-17 13:2, 4 13:11 16:13 20:2]].† (AS)

δράσσομαι [in LXX for נָשַׁק pi., [[psalms 2 12|Psa.2:12;]] elsewhere קָמַץ, as [[leviticus 2 2|Lev.2:2]] ;] to grasp with the hand, to lay hold of: metaphorically, with accusative (M, Pr., 65), [[1-corinthians 3 19|1Co.3:19]] (LXX).† (AS)

δραχμή, -ῆς, ἡ (δράσσομαι), [in LXX: in Hex. for in בֶּקַע, שֶׁקֶל Ezra for אֲדַרְכֹּן, דַּרְכְּמוֹן ;] a drachma, nearly equal to the Roman denarius (see: δηνόριον): [[luke 15 8|Luk.15:8-9]] (DCG, ii, 200).† (AS)
δρέπανον, -ου, τό (later form of Attic δρεπάνη, δρέπω, to pluck), [in LXX for מַזְמֵדָה, חֶרְמֵשׁ, etc. ;] a sickle, pruning-hook; [[mark 4 29|Mrk.4:29]], [[revelation 14 14|Rev.14:14-19]].† (AS)
δρόμος, -ου, ὁ (δραμεῖν, see: τρέχω) [in LXX chiefly for מְרוּצָה ;] a course: figuratively, of life or ministry, [[acts 13 25|Act.13:25 20:24]], [[2-timothy 4 7|2Ti.4:7]].† (AS)
Δρούσιλλα (Rec. Δρουσίλλα), ης, ἡ Drusilla, wife of Felix: [[acts 24 24|Act.24:24.]]† (AS)

δύναμαι, depon., [in LXX chiefly for יָכֹל ;] to be able, have power, whether by personal ability, permission, or opportunity: with inf. (M, Pr., 205; WM, §44, 3) pres., [[matthew 6 24|Mat.6:24]], [[mark 2 7|Mrk.2:7]], [[john 3 2|Jhn.3:2]], [[1-corinthians 10 21|1Co.10:21]], al.; with inf. aor., [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45]], [[john 3 3|Jhn.3:3]], 4 [[romans 8 39|Rom.8:39]], al.; with accusative, to be able to do something: [[mark 9 22|Mrk.9:22]], [[luke 12 26|Luk.12:26;]] [[2-corinthians 13 8|2Co.13:8]]; absol., to be able, capable, powerful: [[1-corinthians 3 2|1Co.3:2 10:13]]. (AS)

δύναμις, -εως, ἡ (δύναμαι), [in LXX for עֹז ,גּבוּרָה ,צָבָה ,(חֵיל) חַיִל, etc.; 35 words in all ;] power, might, strength; relatively, ability, power to perform: [[matthew 25 15|Mat.25:15]], [[acts 3 12|Act.3:12]], [[hebrews 11 11|Heb.11:11]]; κατὰ δ., [[2-corinthians 8 3|2Co.8:3;]] παρὰ δ., ib.; ὑπὲρ δ., [[2-corinthians 1 8|2Co.1:8;]] of pecuniary ability, [[2-corinthians 8 3|2Co.8:3]], [[revelation 18 3|Rev.18:3]]; absol., power, might: [[luke 24 49|Luk.24:49]], [[acts 1 8|Act.1:8]]; opposite to ἀσθένεια, [[1-corinthians 15 43|1Co.15:43;]] ἡ δ. τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[1-corinthians 15 56|1Co.15:56;]] of power in action, [[romans 1 16|Rom.1:16, 20]] [[1-corinthians 1 18|1Co.1:18]], [[philippians 3 10|Php.3:10]], al.; ἡ δ. τ. θεοῦ, [[matthew 22 29|Mat.22:29]], [[mark 12 24|Mrk.12:24]], [[romans 1 20|Rom.1:20]], al.; opposite to μόρφωσις, [[2-timothy 3 5|2Ti.3:5;]] in doxologies, [[revelation 4 11|Rev.4:11 7:12]], al.; ἐν δ., [[mark 9 1|Mrk.9:1]], [[luke 4 36|Luk.4:36]], [[romans 1 4|Rom.1:4]], al.; of the power of performing miracles, [[acts 6 8|Act.6:8]], [[2-thessalonians 2 9|2Th.2:9]]; pl., [[matthew 13 54|Mat.13:54]], [[mark 6 14|Mrk.6:14]], [[galatians 3 5|Gal.3:5]], al.; of the force or meaning of a word (Plat., al.), [[1-corinthians 14 11|1Co.14:11.]] By meton., of persons or things; (a) of God, [[matthew 26 64|Mat.26:64]], [[mark 14 62|Mrk.14:62]] (Dalman, Words, 200ff.); (b) of angels, [[romans 8 38|Rom.8:38]], [[ephesians 1 21|Eph.1:21]], [[1-peter 3 22|1Pe.3:22]]; (with) of armies, pl. [LXX for צְבָאוֹת ], metaphorically, of the stars, [[matthew 24 29|Mat.24:29]], [[mark 13 25|Mrk.13:25]], [[luke 21 26|Luk.21:26]]; (d) of that wh. manifests God's power: Christ, [[1-corinthians 1 24|1Co.1:24;]] τ. εὐαγγέλλιον, [[romans 1 16|Rom.1:16;]] ἡ δ. τ. κυρίου, [[1-corinthians 5 4|1Co.5:4;]] (e) of mighty works (Tr., Syn., §xci), δ. ποιεῖν, [[mark 6 5|Mrk.6:5 9:39]]; pl., [[matthew 7 22|Mat.7:22]], [[mark 6 2|Mrk.6:2]], [[luke 10 13|Luk.10:13]], al.; σημεῖακ. δ., [[acts 8 13|Act.8:13;]] δ. κ. τέρατα κ. σημεῖα, [[acts 2 22|Act.2:22]], [[2-corinthians 12 12|2Co.12:12]]. SYN.: βία, ἐνέργεια, ἐξουσία, ἰσχύς, κράτος (see Tr., l.with; Cremer, 218, 236; DB, i, 616; iv, 29; DCG, i, 607; ii, 188). (AS)

δυναμόω, -ῶ (δύναμις), [in LXX for עָזַז, [[psalms 52 7|Psa.52:7 68:28]]; גָּבַר pi., hi., [[ecclesiastes 10 10|Ecc.10:10]], [[daniel 9 27|Da TH 9:27]] * ;] to make strong, strengthen: [[ephesians 6 10|Eph.6:10]] (WH, mg.; ἐνδυν-, WH, txt., RV), [[colossians 1 11|Col.1:11]], [[hebrews 11 34|Heb.11:34]].† (AS)

δυνάστης, -ου, ὁ (δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, עָרִיץ, בַּיִת, etc. ;] a prince, ruler, potentate: [[luke 1 52|Luk.1:52;]] of God (Sir.46:5, 16, 2Ma.15:3), [[1-timothy 6 15|1Ti.6:15]]; of a high official (cf. δυνάσται Φαραώ, [[genesis 50 4|Gen.50:4]]), [[acts 8 27|Act.8:27]] (Cremer, 221).† (AS)
δυνατέω, -ῶ (δυνατός), to be able, be powerful, mighty: with inf., [[romans 14 4|Rom.14:4]], [[2-corinthians 9 8|2Co.9:8]]; absol., opposite to ἀσθενῶ [[2-corinthians 13 3|2Co.13:3.]]† (AS)

(ἐστι), [[matthew 24 24|Mat.24:24 26:30]], [[mark 13 22|Mrk.13:22 14:35]], [[romans 12 18|Rom.12:18]], [[galatians 4 15|Gal.4:15]]; τὸ δ. (= ἡ δύναμις) αὐτοῦ, [[romans 9 22|Rom.9:22.]]† (AS)

δυσ-βάστακτος, -ον (βαστάζω), [in LXX for נֵטֶל, [[proverbs 27 3|Pro.27:3]] * ;] hard to be borne: [[matthew 23 4|Mat.23:4]] (om. WH, txt., R, mg.), [[luke 11 46|Luk.11:46.]]† (AS)
δυσεντερία, -ας, ἡ, Rec. for δυσεντέριον (which see), [[acts 28 8|Act.28:8.]]† (AS)
δυσερμήνευτος, -ον (ἑρμηνεύω), hard of interpretation: [[hebrews 5 11|Heb.5:11.]]† (AS)

δύσκολος, -ον (κόλον, food), [in LXX for אֵיד, [[jeremiah 29 9|Jer.29:9]] ([[jeremiah 49 8|Jer.49:8]]) (of. δυσκολία, [[job 34 30|Job.34:30;]] εὔκολος, [[2-samuel 15 3|2Ki.15:3]]) * ;] 1. properly, of persons, hard to satisfy with food, hence, generally, hard to please (Eur., Plat.). 2. Of things, difficult, hard (Arist.): [[mark 10 24|Mrk.10:24.]]† (AS)
δυσκόλως adv., with difficulty: [[matthew 19 23|Mat.19:23]], [[mark 10 23|Mrk.10:23]], [[luke 18 24|Luk.18:24]].† (AS)

δυσμή, -ῆς, ἡ (= δύσις, δύνω), [in LXX for בּוֹא, עֲרָבָה, etc. ;] mostly in pl., opposite to ἀνατολαί; 1. a setting, as of the sun (accusative to Thayer, see word, so perhaps in [[luke 12 54|Luk.12:54]]). 2. the quarter of sunset, the west: anarth., [[matthew 8 11|Mat.8:11 24:27]], [[luke 12 54|Luk.12:54 13:29]], [[revelation 21 13|Rev.21:13]].† (AS)
δυσνόητος, -ον (νοέω), hard to understand: [[2-peter 3 16|2Pe.3:16.]]† (AS)
δυσφημία, -ας, ἡ (δύσφημος, slanderous), [in LXX: 1Ma.7:38, 3Ma.2:20 * ;] evil-speaking, defamation: opposite to εὐφημία, [[2-corinthians 6 8|2Co.6:8.]]† (AS)

δώδεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl. numeral, twelve: [[matthew 9 20|Mat.9:20 10:1]], al.; οἱ δ., the apostles, [[matthew 10 5|Mat.10:5]], [[mark 4 10|Mrk.4:10]], al.; in [[acts 19 7|Act.19:7 24:11]], for Rec. δεκαδύο. (AS)
the twelfth , (Homer), etc.: epic δυωδ-, (Homer) (ML)

δῶμα, -τος, τό (δέμω, to build), [in LXX for גָּג ;] chiefly in poets and late (not Attic) prose; 1. a house, hall. 2. In LXX (and Hom., Od., x, 554; cf. MGr., terrace), house-top: ἐπὶ τ. δῶμα, [[luke 5 19|Luk.5:19]], [[acts 10 9|Act.10:9]]; ἐπὶ τ. δώματος, -άτων, [[matthew 10 27|Mat.10:27 24:17]], [[mark 13 15|Mrk.13:15]], [[luke 12 3|Luk.12:3 17:31]].† (AS)

Χριστοῦ, [[ephesians 4 7|Eph.4:7;]] τ. πνεύματος, [[acts 2 38|Act.2:38 10:45]]; τ. δικαιοσύνης, [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17;]] τ. χάριτος, [[ephesians 3 7|Eph.3:7;]] ἀνεκδιηγήτὶῳ δ., [[2-corinthians 9 15|2Co.9:15.]] Acc, δωρεάν, adverbially (as frequently in LXX), (a) freely, as a gift: [[matthew 10 8|Mat.10:8]], [[romans 3 24|Rom.3:24]], [[2-corinthians 11 7|2Co.11:7]], [[2-thessalonians 3 8|2Th.3:8]], [[revelation 21 6|Rev.21:6 22:17]]; (b) in vain, uselessly: ([[john 15 25|Jhn.15:25]] LXX) [[galatians 2 21|Gal.2:21.]]† SYN.: see: δόμα (AS)
